recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見多顆顆粒稀少（hypogranular）的嗜中性球，其中數顆為雙葉、核葉以細橋相連的假 Pelger-Huët 型，另有大型未成熟單核球系／母細胞樣細胞，呈現顆粒球系發育不良。
features: Hypogranular neutrophils and bands with pale grey-pink cytoplasm
Bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Large immature cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (blasts/promonocytes)
Myelocyte-like cells with eccentric round nuclei and grey cytoplasm lacking normal granulation
Small lymphocyte and scattered red cells; platelet-poor background
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors and neutrophils with markedly reduced cytoplasmic granulation and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms. Admixed are several large immature cells with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, representing blasts or promonocytes. Dysgranulopoiesis is evident, and blast percentage should be determined on a 500-cell differential. Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic/myeloid neoplasm in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Congenital Pelger cells are normally granulated and uniformly affect nearly all neutrophils without blasts or cytopenias.
Drug-related changes lack increased blasts and clonal abnormalities and resolve after withdrawal.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: Requires at least 20% blasts on a formal count, which cannot be established from this single field.
